method.space: linear sRGB, constant CIE Y, anchor 0.22
method.procedure: All three pathways are measured, interleaved, and shuffled. Each pair is the same step on both sides of gray. Some pairs are the same color on both cards. A pathway that stays visible at the small step is confirmed once later and then sampled less — it is not dropped. One, two, three, or none may come back high. Pure red and pure blue are references and do not change that reading.
method.priorsRole: Cone-isolation directions only choose where to look first. They are not the output.

summary: Las tres vías quedan medidas. violáceo 0.004. rojizo 0.019. verdoso 0.015. Control 0.005. Quedan por encima «rojizo» y «verdoso». No elijo un ángulo: pueden ir altas una, dos o las tres. También mido «rojo extremo» 0.010. En el extremo de la pantalla, «azul extremo» 0.003.

fit.method: Peak absolute distance in linear sRGB (unit direction × scale), compared with the control. Gamut fraction is not the rank: a short-gamut axis must not look worse just because it clips sooner.
